query: Pick up GitHub issue owner/repo#42 and set up a branch for it.
expected_behavior: Detects owner/repo#42 as a GitHub issue (not a Jira ticket) from the input format and looks it up to use as the spec
Runs the bundled scripts/start-ticket.sh to create the branch and worktree rather than improvising the git steps
Handles the GitHub path (no Jira transition) and moves into the worktree to begin the implementation against the issue
Scaffolds the workspace and kicks off work only: it does not commit, promote, or open a PR
